name: beredskapsboka
description: Offline-first Norwegian Civil Defence field-support PWA with local missions, checklists, map/log workflow and privacy-safe exports.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:content && pnpm run build:sw && pnpm run build:app
scripts.start: mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && rm -rf .next/standalone/public .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -R public .next/standalone/public && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cd .next/standalone && node server.js
scripts.e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e:prod:no-build
scripts.e2e:prod: pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e:prod:no-build
scripts.map:fetch: gh release download map-packages-20260610 --pattern '*.pmtiles' --dir public/map-packages --clobber && shasum -a 256 -c scripts/map-packages.sha256
scripts.build:content: pnpm run import:obsidian && pnpm run compile:curated && pnpm run build:search && pnpm run sync:workplans && pnpm run validate:content
scripts.check:generated: git diff --cached --exit-code -- content/generated/source-documents.json content/generated/source-snapshot-metadata.json content/workplans/workplans.json && git diff --exit-code -- content/generated/source-documents.json content/generated/source-snapshot-metadata.json content/workplans/workplans.json
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run audit:ci && pnpm run check:workplans && pnpm run build:content && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run build:sw && pnpm run check:sw && pnpm run validate:maps && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:app && pnpm run e2e:prod:no-build && pnpm run perf:budget && pnpm run perf:lighthouse
scripts.deploy:vinext: pnpm run build:vinext && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
